newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA BEAT TONGA 74-10 IN INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA BEAT TONGA 74-10 IN INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: South Africa beat Tonga 74-10 (halftime 33-3) in a rugby union international on Tuesday.
South Africa - Tries: James Small (2), Ruben Kruger (2), Fritz van Heerden, Andre Snyman (3), Adrian Garvey (2), Naka Drotske, Joost van der Westhuizen. Conversions: Edrich Lubbe (7).
Tonga - Try: Ngaslu Ta'u. Conversion: Siau Tau'ma'lolo. Penalty: Gustavo Tonga.
